entities.name: Alexander von Humboldt
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Prussian naturalist and explorer (1769–1859) whose five-year expedition through Latin America (1799–1804) revolutionized the natural sciences. He mapped the Orinoco-Amazon connection, climbed Chimborazo, measured ocean currents, and pioneered the concept of nature as an interconnected whole. More species and places are named after him than any other human.
